correctness.rationale: Oddness makes the opposite support number exactly cos(pi/m). The excluded center polygon is unavoidable. Nearest-vertex sector coverage is proved by checking five explicit extremal points against one vertex translate; arithmetic conditions are t>=1 and m>=5. This proves the set identity, including its boundary and the t=sec endpoint; convex addition proves persistence, and an outer support-edge gap proves nonconvexity for t<1. Polygon area proves exact area law and asymptotics. Independent numerical union comparisons are consistent, not a universal proof.

value.rationale: Provides a complete quantitative geometric answer to a natural continuous Minkowski convexification process on an infinite family of non-zonotopal planar polytopes. The exact missing regular-polygon region, sharp threshold, quadratic vanishing and high-order large-m deficit are structural, explicitly motivated measurements of the manner—not merely the existence—of finite convexification. It is neither an arbitrary finite slice nor a mere parameter renaming.
